missing.line: In the great void of my life I could feel the shape of what was missing
stanza: Quickly forgotten was that forgetful way of life
When I left home, when I lived as if I'd died
Sitting on a rock and doing nothing

missing.line: I had the feeling that something was missing
stanza: And when I was 12 years old
My daddy took me to the circus,
The greatest show on earth
There were clowns and elephants, dancing bears
And a beautiful lady in pink tights flew high above our heads
As I sat there watching
I had the feeling that something was missing
I don't know what
When it was all over I said to myself
"Is that all there is to the circus?"

missing.line: I thought of old friends, the ones who'd gone missing
